headline: Snowy Hydro 2.0 Projected Cost Surges to A$25 Billion With Delays to 2029
summary: Australia's Snowy 2.0 pumped hydro project faces delivery delays extending into late 2029, with estimated total costs escalating to 12 times its original budget, reaching A$25 billion.
why: Snowy Hydro is Australia's cornerstone renewable energy storage project, central to the country's national grid transition.

impacts.name: Australia
impacts.why: Cost overruns and delays increase public energy transition expenditures and prolong grid capacity risks.
